crossRefs.note: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with its towns…
the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside…
Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel. No one went out, and no one came in.
Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time, saying, “Cursed is the man before Yahweh who rises up and builds this…
They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

people.name: Ataroth
people.line: A town on the border of Ephraim and Manasseh.

people.name: Janoah

people.name: Jericho

people.name: Jordan

people.name: Naaran

translations.web: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
translations.bsb: From Janoah it went down to Ataroth and Naarah, and then reached Jericho and came out at the Jordan.
translations.kjv: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
translations.asv: and it went down from Janoah to Ataroth, and to Naarah, and reached unto Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
